**Finding: WARRANTY — compliant (no redline).**

Section 19 satisfies our fallback checklist on its material terms and reaches most of the preferred position:

- **Professional and workmanlike** — 19.1, by qualified personnel and to industry standards.
- **Conformance to documentation** — 19.1 (Services and Deliverables) with 19.2 durations: 90 days from the later of delivery or acceptance for Deliverables, and the full subscription term for hosted software (the defined "Services" expressly includes hosted software), so both the software (≥90 days) and services (≥30 days) floors are cleared.
- **Remedies** — 19.4 gives prompt re-performance/repair/replacement at no charge and, on failure to cure, termination of the affected item plus refund of Fees paid; expressly non-exclusive for fraud, infringement, confidentiality, privacy, security and indemnified claims.
- **Compliance with law / no malicious code** — 19.3.
- **Disclaimer** — 19.5 is mutual, limited to implied warranties, and expressly does not cut back any express warranty, service level, indemnity or remedy, so it does not swallow the warranty.

Noted in the rationale rather than flagged: the malicious-code warranty is qualified to code "intentionally introduced by Vendor", and 19.1's performance warranty has no stated period (which favours us). Neither is a material fallback failure, so we do not redline.
